understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece simultaneously on the goal tiles marked '+' in each level, progressing through all levels until the game reported WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move on a 3-pixel-per-cell grid using directional actions. Adjacent pushable blocks can be pushed, while walls and boundaries can block movement; movement hints are not always definitive. Multiple pieces can be controlled by clicking their exact pixel/grid coordinates, but repeated clicks on an already selected or inaccessible position consume steps without changing the state.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece simultaneously on the goal tiles marked '+' in each level, progressing through all levels until the game reported WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move on a 3-pixel-per-cell grid using directional actions. Adjacent pushable blocks can be pushed, while walls and boundaries can block movement; movement hints are not always definitive. Multiple pieces can be controlled by clicking their exact pixel/grid coordinates, but repeated clicks on an already selected or inaccessible position consume steps without changing the state.
